resources.string: Dictation bubble for any text field

Telltype shows a small microphone bubble when you type in a text field. It reads which field has focus and the text around the cursor, and types what you dictate into that field. Password and number fields are skipped. Speech is sent only to the server you set up.
Telltype is using the microphone for a dictation.
